Question.
Consider the Grassmannian G​r​(n,2​n)Gr(n,2n) of nn-planes in ℂ2​n\mathbb{C}^{2n}. Let R=⨁m=0∞RmR=\bigoplus_{m=0}^{\infty}R_{m} denote the (homogeneous) coordinate ring of G​r​(n,2​n)Gr(n,2n), so that RmR_{m} is the degree-mm part. Let BB be a symplectic form on ℂ2​n\mathbb{C}^{2n}. The map φB:G​r​(n,2​n)→G​r​(n,2​n)\varphi_{B}\colon Gr(n,2n)\to Gr(n,2n) which sends each subspace UU to U⟂U^{\perp}, its orthogonal complement with respect to BB, is an automorphism of G​r​(n,2​n)Gr(n,2n) (as an algebraic variety). Hence, via pull-back, it induces an automorphism, also denoted φB\varphi_{B}, on the ring RR and on each homogeneous component RmR_{m}. What is the trace of φB\varphi_{B} acting on RmR_{m}, when n=3n=3 and m=2m=2?

Solution.
This is the same as the number of symmetric (i.e., transpose-invariant) plane partitions of shape n×nn\times n and entries in {0,1,…,m}\{0,1,\ldots,m\}, as discussed in [K] and [H]. The number 3535 can then be computed from the famous product formula

Another way to do it is directly with the standard monomial basis. Recall that, in general for the Grassmannian G​r​(a,a+b)Gr(a,a+b) of aa-planes in ℂa+b\mathbb{C}^{a+b}, and its coordinate ring R=⨁m=0∞RmR=\bigoplus_{m=0}^{\infty}R_{m}, a basis of RmR_{m} is indexed by the semistandard Young tableaux (SSYT) of shape mam^{a} (i.e., mm columns of length aa), with entries in {1,…,a+b}\{1,\ldots,a+b\}: we associate to each such tableau TT the product of the Plücker coordinates corresponding to the columns of TT. In the case when a=b=na=b=n, the automorphism φB\varphi_{B} acts as a permutation on this basis in the following way: we replace each column by its reflected complement in {1,…,2​n}\{1,\ldots,2n\} (where reflected complement means we first replace each ii by 2​n+1−i2n+1-i, and then take the complement).

So, without using plane partitions, the problem boils down to counting 3×23\times 2 SSYT whose columns are invariant under the reflected complement operation, which can also be directly counted to be 3535.
